metadata.title: On Stellar Migration from Andromeda to the Milky Way

notes: No individual stars are identified or analysed. The paper simulates an ensemble of hypervelocity-star trajectories (e.g., T:p3-b8; T:p4-b16) and compares aggregate results with an unnamed Gaia DR3 sample (T:p7-b7); prior HVS catalogues are discussed only collectively (T:p1-b13).
